name: corn
_note: also the seed for the corn field

log: The raw kernels are hard and starchy, requiring patient chewing.
The uncooked corn proves tough, with only a trace of sweetness.
You strip the small kernels from the cob with your teeth.

actions.label: roast
log: You turn an ear of corn among the embers until its kernels begin to burst.
The outer husk blackens, but the grain beneath ripens to a golden colour.
A pleasant sweetness rises from the corn as it roasts over the heat.
